skills.name: caveman
skills.description: Compressed communication mode. ~75% token reduction. Use for handoffs and long-context summaries.

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Systematic debug guidance when a worker report is BLOCKED or tests are failing in unclear ways.

skills.name: merge-work
skills.description: Safely integrate approved worker output into the repo. Runs hooks, formats, tests, updates state.

skills.name: plan-wave
skills.description: Decompose a PRD section into a wave with spec, plan, tasks, and contracts. Use at the start of every wave.

skills.name: review-report
skills.description: Verify a worker report against acceptance contracts and spec. Boris's #1 rule — always run commands yourself.

skills.name: self-evolve
skills.description: After each wave, capture lessons that should change the orchestrator's behavior. Hermes-style learning loop.

skills.name: status-report
skills.description: Generate a standardized weekly project status report.

skills.name: to-issues
skills.description: Decompose a PRD section into vertical-slice waves. Each wave ships an end-to-end demo.

skills.name: to-prd
skills.description: Convert a discussion or rough scope into a formal PRD section. Use when user describes new requirements.

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Categorize incoming work — bug / feature / question / scope creep — and route appropriately.

skills.name: verify-work
skills.description: Boris's #1 rule. Run executable acceptance criteria yourself, never trust worker's claim.

skills.name: write-task-file
skills.description: Produce self-contained worker task briefs that require zero project context to execute. Use when dispatching work to OpenCode CLI workers.

skills.name: zoom-out
skills.description: When stuck in details, request broader context. Re-read PRD, ARCHITECTURE, EXECUTION before deciding.
